items.source: The properties are applied every time CodecConfigurer.getReaders() or CodecConfigurer.getWriters() are used to obtain the list of configured readers or writers.
items.translation: 这些属性会在每次使用 CodecConfigurer.getReaders() 或 CodecConfigurer.getWriters() 获取配置的读取器或写入器列表时应用。

items.source: The consumer is called every time CodecConfigurer.getReaders() or CodecConfigurer.getWriters() are used to obtain the list of configured readers or writers.
items.translation: 每当使用 CodecConfigurer.getReaders() 或 CodecConfigurer.getWriters() 获取配置的读取器或写入器列表时，都会调用该消费者。

items.source:
Register a custom codec. This is expected to be one of the following:
  • HttpMessageReader
  • HttpMessageWriter
  • Encoder (wrapped internally with EncoderHttpMessageWriter)
  • Decoder (wrapped internally with DecoderHttpMessageReader)
items.translation:
注册自定义编解码器。预期类型如下：
  • HttpMessageReader
  • HttpMessageWriter
  • Encoder（内部包装为 EncoderHttpMessageWriter）
  • Decoder（内部包装为 DecoderHttpMessageReader）

items.source: Variant of register(Object) that also applies the below properties, if configured, via CodecConfigurer.defaultCodecs(): maxInMemorySize enableLoggingRequestDetails
items.translation: `register(Object)` 的变体，如果通过 CodecConfigurer.defaultCodecs() 配置了以下属性，也会应用这些属性： maxInMemorySize enableLoggingRequestDetails

items.source: Variant of register(Object) that also allows the caller to apply the properties from CodecConfigurer.DefaultCodecConfig to the given codec.
items.translation: `register(Object)` 的变体，它还允许调用者将来自CodecConfigurer.DefaultCodecConfig的属性应用到给定的编码器。

items.source: codec - the codec to register and apply default config to
items.translation: codec - 要注册并应用默认配置的编解码器

items.source: Registry for custom HTTP message readers and writers.
items.translation: 用于自定义 HTTP 消息读取器和写入器的注册表。
